title: Lathe Master Unified Roadmap
product_promise: Print to CNC program in one shot. Extreme level of intelligence and coordination. Quality parity with Universal skills/scripts/hooks roadmap.
brief: Unified lathe roadmap consolidating 9 prior envelopes into one 18-phase, 135-unit master plan targeting 5 concrete PRISM app features (Speed/Feed Calculator, Post-Processor Generator, Master Post-Processor, Print-to-Program, ERP/Business) on a shared AGI substrate (deep learning, deep reasoning, deep logic, neural networking, near-AGI intelligence) plus v2 scrutiny gaps (formal verification, local LLM/LoRA, Bayesian/causal depth, asset utilization, AGI safety containment, live machine data, predictive twin, multi-agent orchestration, scientific simulation depth, optimal control + info gain + ensemble, and frontend integration into the Codex-built PRISM web app).

phases.title: Formal G-Code Verification (Z3/SMT)
phases.goal: Add formal verification layer so emitted G-code is provably safe (no travel-limit violation, no G0-through-stock, monotone Z in finishing, tool-holder clearance, coolant gates, spindle gates). Closes the 'one-shot' promise with mathematical certainty.

units.title: LatheProgramSMTEncoderEngine
units.description: Parses emitted G-code -> SMT-LIB encoding (LIA/LRA/NRA). Variables: (x,z,feed,rpm,tool,coolant,state). Generates constraints per block.

units.title: LatheFormalProofEngine (7 properties)
units.description: Runs Z3 to prove: (1) axis travel within limits, (2) no G0 through stock, (3) monotone Z in finish cycle, (4) clearance >= min_z after retract, (5) coolant on when cutting, (6) spindle on before motion, (7) tool change at safe position.
exit_conditions: All 7 properties produce SAT/UNSAT with counterexample trace

units.title: LatheDenotationalSemanticsEngine
units.description: Maps G-code operational semantics to denotational model — state transformer [[P]]: Sigma -> Sigma for each block. Composable proofs.
exit_conditions: Semantic function for G0, G1, G2/G3, G71, G76 tested
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

units.title: LatheTemporalPropertyCheckerEngine (bounded LTL)
units.description: Encodes bounded LTL-to-SMT translation for temporal safety: 'G ( motion -> X (not G0 within stock) )' etc. Bounded k-step.
exit_conditions: Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

units.title: LatheProofCacheEngine (memoization)
units.description: Memoizes proofs keyed by (program_hash, machine_envelope_hash, property_id). Re-emissions of unchanged segments skip re-proof.
exit_conditions: Cache hit ratio > 80% on incremental emits
Cache invalidates on machine profile change
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

units.title: Forge-Triple for Formal Verification
units.description: Hook post-lathe-emit-proof.mjs (runs SMT on every emitted program) + action prism_lathe:formal_prove + skill /lathe-prove.
exit_conditions: Hook blocks emit on unproved property

phases.exit_gate: Every emitted G-code program passes Z3 SMT verification for all 7 safety properties OR is rejected with counterexample trace identifying offending block.

units.title: LatheLoRADatasetBuilderEngine
units.description: Builds training corpus: {prompt=operation+material+tool, completion=validated G-code block} from 20k JM Die programs + 3700 tips. Deduplicates + class-balances.

units.title: scripts/train-lathe-lora.py (QLoRA 4-bit NF4, r=16, alpha=32)

units.title: LatheLoRAEvalHarnessEngine
units.description: Eval harness: BLEU on held-out programs, safety-property pass rate via P0.1 SMT encoder, machinist A/B test. Rejects LoRA if safety rate < base model.

units.title: scripts/merge-and-quant-lathe-lora.py (GGUF Q5_K_M)
units.description: Merges LoRA weights into base, converts to GGUF Q5_K_M via llama.cpp. Produces lathe-jmdie-q5km.gguf artifact.

units.title: lathe-jmdie.Modelfile + LatheLocalPolicyEngine

phases.title: Bayesian + Causal Depth
phases.goal: Upgrade cutting force / tool life / Cpk from frequentist point estimates to Bayesian joint posteriors (NIG conjugate), hierarchical partial pooling, and true do-operator causal inference via PC algorithm + Meek orientation. Required for print-to-program uncertainty gating.

units.title: Extend KienzleBayesianEngine with NIG conjugate
units.description: Current: Gaussian on kc1.1. New: Normal-Inverse-Gamma joint prior on (mu, sigma^2), closed-form posterior update via sufficient stats {n, xbar, S}.
exit_conditions: Posterior means within 1% of MCMC on 3 test datasets
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

units.title: Joint (C, n) Taylor posterior
units.description: Extend TaylorToolLifeModelEngine with joint Bayesian posterior on (C, n) via Student-t marginalization. Credibility intervals.
exit_conditions: 95% credibility interval covers observed T on 10 holdout cases
Correlation between C and n surfaced
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

units.title: HierarchicalBayesianCuttingForceEngine (partial pooling)
units.description: Material-group-level hyperprior, shop-level offset, job-level draw. Gibbs sampler (1000 burn, 5000 draws). Rhat < 1.05.
exit_conditions: Partial pooling beats no-pooling by >=5% RMSE on holdout
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

units.title: PC algorithm causal discovery
units.description: PC algorithm with Fisher-Z conditional independence test on {Vc, fn, ap, material, tool_geometry, machine, Ra, T_life, Fc}. Outputs CPDAG; Meek orientation -> DAG.
exit_conditions: Produces CPDAG on JM Die dataset
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

units.title: True do-operator via back-door adjustment
units.description: Replace current 'causal' engine stubs with P(Y | do(X)) = Sum_z P(Y | X, Z) P(Z). Back-door set computed from DAG.
exit_conditions: do-operator differs from conditional on confounded edges
Identification fails gracefully on unidentifiable queries
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

units.title: gateBayesian() for E1203 CpkPredictionGateEngine
units.description: Extend E1203 (from CAMX-MS12) with Bayesian Cpk via non-central t. Gate on P(Cpk > 1.33) >= 0.90 instead of Cpk_point > 1.33.
exit_conditions: Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

units.title: Forge-Triple for Bayesian Posterior Gate
units.description: Hook post-strategy-require-posterior-gate.mjs + action prism_lathe:posterior_gate + skill /lathe-posterior-gate.
exit_conditions: Hook blocks strategy accept on posterior Cpk P < 0.90
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

phases.exit_gate: Strategy accept requires Bayesian P(Cpk > 1.33) >= 0.90 (not point estimate). Causal queries use true do-operator via back-door adjustment. Rhat < 1.05 on all hierarchical samplers.

phases.title: Predictive Twin (60s Pre-Play)
phases.goal: Before emitting G-code to machine, simulate 60s of execution with per-block physics (Kienzle + 1D thermal FD + cantilever deflection + stability lobe) in 2D XZ polygon booleans via manifold-3d. 8ms/block target. Validates within 15/20/25% MAPE before emit.

units.title: LatheManifoldXZPolygonEngine (manifold-3d wrap, 2ms/op)
units.description: Wraps manifold-3d for 2D XZ polygon booleans (turning projection). Stock state as CSG tree. Per-block diff = new swept volume.
exit_conditions: Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

units.title: LathePerBlockPhysicsEngine (Kienzle + thermal + deflection + stability, 8ms/block)
units.description: For each block: compute Fc (Kienzle), T (1D thermal FD), delta (cantilever), stability (SLD lookup). Cached material props.
exit_conditions: All 4 values within 10% of slow reference
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

units.title: LathePredictiveTwinOrchestratorEngine (60s budget)
units.description: Runs per-block physics on 60s of simulated execution. Hard budget 60s wall-clock. Early-abort on catastrophic prediction.
exit_conditions: Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

units.title: LatheTwinValidationReportEngine (MAPE gates 15%/20%/25%)
units.description: Compares twin predictions vs live telemetry (P0.6). MAPE on cycle_time (<=15%), peak_force (<=20%), peak_temp (<=25%). Gate emit on fail.

units.title: LatheTwinCalibrationEngine
units.description: Bayesian calibration of twin parameters against telemetry. Updates material-group priors monthly.
exit_conditions: Calibration reduces MAPE by >=3% over static
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

global_physics_policy.rationale: All lathe-physics units MUST cite canonical formulas by name and import constants from src/physics/constants.ts. Never inline.

named_formulas_registry.cutting_force: Kienzle (Fc = kc1.1 * b * h^(1-mc)); source: src/physics/constants.ts kc1.1 per ISO group
named_formulas_registry.tool_life: Taylor extended (V*T^n*f^a*d^b = C); source: src/physics/constants.ts TAYLOR_CONSTANTS
named_formulas_registry.stability_lobes: Altintas SLD (chatter-free axial depth vs spindle speed); cite: Altintas, Manufacturing Automation (2012)
named_formulas_registry.chip_thinning: Martellotti radial engagement correction (heff = hth * cos(phi_engage)); cite: Machinery's Handbook 31e
named_formulas_registry.thermal_cutting: Carslaw-Jaeger moving heat source + Loewen-Shaw partition; cite: Carslaw-Jaeger Conduction of Heat in Solids
named_formulas_registry.grinding_thermal: Malkin Cgs model (energy partition in grinding); cite: Malkin & Guo, Grinding Technology (2008)
named_formulas_registry.abrasive_wear: Sato velocity-dependent wear; cite: Sato et al., CIRP Annals
named_formulas_registry.surface_finish_turning: Ra = f^2/(32*r_nose) + Brammertz correction; cite: Sandvik Modern Metal Cutting
named_formulas_registry.deflection: Cantilever beam (delta = F*L^3/(3*E*I)); cite: Shigley's Mechanical Engineering Design
named_formulas_registry.swiss_guide_bushing: Force limit = k_bushing * stickout_ratio; source: Citizen / Tsugami OEM specs
named_formulas_registry.live_tool_torque: T_live = P_spindle * eta / omega_live; source: Okuma / Mazak B-axis specs

global_physics_policy.constants_import_mandate: import { kc1_1, mc, taylor_n, taylor_C, E_carbide, ALTINTAS_SLD_CONSTANTS, MALKIN_CGS, BRAMMERTZ_COEFF, SATO_WEAR_CONSTANTS, BUSHING_K_SWISS, LIVE_TOOL_TORQUE_MAX, TOOL_NOSE_RADIUS, WHITE_LAYER_THRESHOLDS, CARSLAW_JAEGER_PECLET, LOEWEN_SHAW_PARTITION } from "src/physics/constants.ts" — NEVER inline. Missing constants must be added to constants.ts (with Sandvik/Kennametal/Machinery's Handbook citation) before physics unit can claim exit.
global_physics_policy.safety_gate_Sx: S(x) >= 0.70 per safety-physics agent for ALL force/thermal/stress calculations. Hard block if < 0.70.
global_physics_policy.citation_requirement: Every physics unit's knowledge_sources MUST cite Sandvik / Kennametal / Machinery's Handbook / MIT OCW / published paper. Unsourced formulas blocked at physics-review-agent.

global_exit_gate_policy.rationale: User explicitly requires omega=1.0 for ALL future milestones (MEMORY.md). All 135 unit-level omega_floor upgraded to 1.0 on 2026-04-17. Every exit gate must be measurable, not subjective.
